cells: Blizzard Entertainment held BlizzCon 2026 at Anaheim Convention Center in Anaheim, California.
The Tokyo Game Show was held at the Makuhari Messe in Chiba, Japan. Planned activity for the 21st was cancelled due to the anticipated arrival of Typhoon Dujuan.

Paramount Skydance completed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery for $110 billion, becoming Skydance Corporation. This included merging of Warner Bros. Games and its studios with Paramount Games Studio.
The 2026 Esports Awards are scheduled to be held in Miami, Florida.
